# Upstream snapshot (trimmed)

This folder is a **trimmed** snapshot of the upstream GPL-3.0 library used as protocol/fonts reference for lcd-monitor-mini.

Kept:
- `library/` — protocol helpers / reference
- `res/fonts/jetbrains-mono/` — default UI font
- license / authors / readme from upstream

Removed for repo size (not required by this product): upstream themes, most fonts, tests, tools, nested `.git`.

Product themes live in `/themes` and `/packaging/seed`.
